sending.about: pipeline/queue.mjs plans each day's emails for approval; pipeline/send.mjs sends an approved list. Per mailbox: start = the date of its first cold email (until set, it sends nothing); daily = {first, step}: first emails on the start day, +step every weekday after (Instantly's ramp: start small, +2 a day); max = hard ceiling (10 until the mailboxes are fully warmed up).
